assessments.rationale: The core-zone section affirmatively states the console is reached with the same accounts and the same sign-in path customers use, enabled by an is_admin flag, and states what the console can reach.
The notification section affirmatively states the templates log the full rendered body — name, address, and delivery window — to the shared application log.

The data-zone section states the copies exist and that their retention has not been written down anywhere the team could point to; whether a retention practice exists at all cannot be determined from that.
missing_evidence: how long the nightly warehouse copies are kept
whether a lifecycle policy expires old copies

assessments.rationale: The cited passage states the reachability restriction as a fact of the deployment; no passage establishes what enforces it.
missing_evidence: how the data zone is restricted to the core services
whether the restriction is enforced by network policy or assumed by topology
